questions.q: Which variable name follows camelCase?
questions.qAf: Watter veranderlikenaam volg camelCase?
questions.explain: camelCase starts small and capitalises the next words.
questions.explainAf: camelCase begin klein en gee die volgende woorde 'n hoofletter.

questions.q: Which tag must every item in a list be wrapped in?
questions.qAf: In watter etiket moet elke lysitem toegedraai word?
questions.explain: <li> goes inside <ul> or <ol>.

questions.q: How do you make a picture that opens a website when clicked?
questions.qAf: Hoe maak jy 'n prent wat 'n webwerf oopmaak wanneer daarop geklik word?
questions.explain: A clickable image is an inside an .

questions.q: Which way of applying CSS is the worst?
questions.qAf: Watter manier om CSS toe te pas, is die swakste?
questions.explain: Inline CSS must be added to each line separately.
questions.explainAf: Inlyn-CSS moet by elke reël afsonderlik bygevoeg word.

questions.q: Cells A1 to A5 hold 4, 8, (empty), Absent, 12. What does =AVERAGE(A1:A5) give?
questions.qAf: Selle A1 tot A5 bevat 4, 8, (leeg), Afwesig, 12. Wat gee =AVERAGE(A1:A5)?
questions.explain: AVERAGE ignores text and blanks: 24 ÷ 3 = 8.
questions.explainAf: AVERAGE ignoreer teks en leë selle: 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

questions.q: Which formula gives the smallest value in C2 to C31?
questions.qAf: Watter formule gee die kleinste waarde in C2 tot C31?
questions.explain: =MIN(C2,C31) only compares two cells.

questions.q: A sketch has zero DOF left and has turned green. It is…
questions.qAf: 'n Skets het nul DOF oor en het groen geword. Dit is…
questions.explain: Fully constrained is the goal for every sketch.
questions.explainAf: Volledig beperk is die doel vir elke skets.

questions.q: You can still drag a point of the sketch to a new place. It is…
questions.qAf: Jy kan nog 'n punt van die skets na 'n nuwe plek sleep. Dit is…
questions.explain: It still has degrees of freedom.

questions.q: The sketch shows orange because constraints conflict. It is…
questions.qAf: Die skets wys oranje omdat beperkings bots. Dit is…
questions.explain: Too many constraints cause conflicts and errors.
questions.explainAf: Te veel beperkings veroorsaak konflikte en foute.

questions.q: How many degrees of freedom does a freely drawn line have?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel vryheidsgrade het 'n lyn wat vry geteken is?
questions.explain: Up/down, left/right, length and angle.

questions.q: Which constraint fixes a point horizontally and vertically at the same time?
questions.qAf: Watter beperking maak 'n punt horisontaal en vertikaal gelyktydig vas?
questions.explain: Lock applies both at once.

questions.q: What is a fillet?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n fillet?
options: A rounded edge on a sharp corner
questions.explain: Sharp corners are weak and unsafe.
questions.explainAf: Skerp hoeke is swak en onveilig.

questions.q: For variable motor speed, the enable pin must go to which kind of Arduino pin?
questions.qAf: Vir veranderlike motorspoed moet die enable-pen aan watter soort Arduino-pen gaan?
questions.explain: Only ~ pins produce PWM.

questions.q: What are the two states of a digital pin?
questions.qAf: Wat is die twee toestande van 'n digitale pen?
questions.explain: Digital is on or off.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Pattern recognition helps us to predict outcomes and reduce effort.
questions.qAf: Patroonherkenning help ons om uitkomste te voorspel en moeite te verminder.
questions.explain: E.g. weather forecasts, and using a loop for repeated commands.
questions.explainAf: Bv. weervoorspellings, en 'n lus gebruik vir herhaalde opdragte.

questions.q: Construction lines appear blue.
questions.qAf: Konstruksielyne verskyn blou.
questions.explain: They are guides, never part of the 3D model.
questions.explainAf: Hulle is hulplyne, nooit deel van die 3D-model nie.

questions.q: To change a dimension you must delete the line and draw it again.
questions.qAf: Om 'n afmeting te verander, moet jy die lyn skrap en dit weer teken.
questions.explain: Double-click the constraint and type the new value.
questions.explainAf: Dubbelklik op die beperking en tik die nuwe waarde.

questions.q: A potentiometer is an analog input, while a pushbutton is a digital input.
questions.qAf: 'n Potensiometer is 'n analoë inset, terwyl 'n drukknoppie 'n digitale inset is.
questions.explain: Analog inputs give a range of values; digital inputs are only HIGH or LOW.
questions.explainAf: Analoë insette gee 'n reeks waardes; digitale insette is net HIGH of LOW.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each piece of information in column A with the data type that should store it in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke stukkie inligting in kolom A by die datatipe wat dit moet stoor in kolom B.
questions.explain: Whole numbers: int; decimals: double; true or false: boolean. String would be for text.
questions.explainAf: Heelgetalle: int; desimale: double; true of false: boolean. String sou vir teks wees.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each comment to the language it belongs to.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke kommentaar aan die taal waaraan dit behoort.
questions.explain: // is a Java single-line comment, <!-- --> an HTML comment and /* */ a CSS comment.

questions.q: Match each function in column A with what it counts in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke funksie in kolom A by wat dit tel in kolom B.
pairs: Every cell that is not empty
pairsAf: Elke sel wat nie leeg is nie
questions.explain: COUNT counts numbers only.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each pillar of computational thinking to an example of it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke pilaar van berekeningsdenke aan 'n voorbeeld daarvan.
pairs: Splitting a school fun day into food, games and tickets
A weather forecast based on trends
A map that shows only roads and landmarks
Precise steps for a robot to make a sandwich
pairsAf: Om 'n skoolpretdag in kos, speletjies en kaartjies op te deel
'n Kaart wat net paaie en landmerke wys
Presiese stappe vir 'n robot om 'n toebroodjie te maak
questions.explain: Decomposition splits the problem, pattern recognition predicts from repeats, abstraction leaves out detail, and an algorithm is a precise set of steps.
questions.explainAf: Ontbinding verdeel die probleem, patroonherkenning voorspel uit herhalings, abstraksie laat besonderhede uit, en 'n algoritme is 'n presiese stel stappe.

sections.title: Missing syntax
sections.intro: Type the missing symbol or word in each box.
sections.introAf: Tik die simbool of woord wat ontbreek in elke blokkie.

questions.q: Type what is missing from this loop: a symbol and the increment.
questions.qAf: Tik wat in hierdie lus ontbreek: 'n simbool en die inkrement.
questions.explain: A semicolon separates the parts. Both increments are accepted: counter++ and counter = counter + 1.
questions.explainAf: 'n Kommapunt skei die dele. Albei inkremente word aanvaar: counter++ en counter = counter + 1.

questions.q: Type the two symbols missing from this CSS rule.
questions.qAf: Tik die twee simbole wat in hierdie CSS-reël ontbreek.
questions.explain: A rule opens with { and each declaration ends with ;.
questions.explainAf: 'n Reël begin met { en elke deklarasie eindig met ;.

questions.q: Type the symbol every Excel calculation starts with.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool waarmee elke Excel-berekening begin.
questions.explain: Every formula and function starts with =.
questions.explainAf: Elke formule en funksie begin met =.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Sello writes this program for his Gogga, rex.
questions.scenarioAf: Sello skryf hierdie program vir sy Gogga, rex.

questions.q: How many times does rex turn right?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer draai rex regs?
questions.explain: Both lines are inside the loop, which runs 5 times (0 to 4).
questions.explainAf: Albei reëls is binne die lus, wat 5 keer loop (0 tot 4).

questions.q: Sello wants rex to move 8 times. What must the condition be?
questions.qAf: Sello wil hê rex moet 8 keer beweeg. Wat moet die voorwaarde wees?
questions.explain: From 0, counter < 8 runs 8 times.

questions.q: Which part of the loop is int counter = 0?
questions.qAf: Watter deel van die lus is int counter = 0?
questions.explain: Initialisation sets the start value.

questions.q: In rex.move(), what is move()?
questions.qAf: Wat is move() in rex.move()?
questions.explain: Methods are what an object does.

questions.scenario: Grade 9 collects data for three charts.
questions.scenarioAf: Graad 9 versamel data vir drie grafieke.

questions.q: The temperature every day for a month. Which chart?
questions.qAf: Die temperatuur elke dag vir 'n maand. Watter grafiek?
questions.explain: Trends over time: a line chart.

questions.q: The sales of five kinds of fruit. Which chart?
questions.qAf: Die verkope van vyf soorte vrugte. Watter grafiek?
questions.explain: Comparing categories: bar or column.

questions.q: The share of votes each candidate got. Which chart?
questions.qAf: Die deel van die stemme wat elke kandidaat gekry het. Watter grafiek?
questions.explain: Parts of a whole: pie.

questions.scenario: A school gate opens by itself: a camera reads a number plate, a program checks it against a list, and a motor opens the gate.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Skoolhek gaan vanself oop: 'n kamera lees 'n nommerplaat, 'n program kyk of dit op 'n lys is, en 'n motor maak die hek oop.

questions.q: In the IPO model, what is the camera?
questions.qAf: Wat is die kamera in die IPO-model?
questions.explain: It reads the world: input.

questions.q: What is checking the plate against the list?
questions.qAf: Wat is om die nommerplaat teen die lys na te gaan?
questions.explain: Logic and decisions are processing.

questions.q: What is the motor opening the gate?
questions.qAf: Wat is die motor wat die hek oopmaak?
questions.explain: The result: output.

questions.scenario: Zola uses a potentiometer to dim an LED: one side to 5 V, the other to ground, the middle pin to A0.
questions.scenarioAf: Zola gebruik 'n potensiometer om 'n LED dof te maak: een kant na 5 V, die ander na grond, die middelste pen na A0.

questions.q: What is the middle pin called?
questions.qAf: Wat word die middelste pen genoem?
questions.explain: A potentiometer has a central wiper.
questions.explainAf: 'n Potensiometer het 'n sleper in die middel.

questions.q: The reading is 1000. What value is sent to the LED?
questions.qAf: Die lesing is 1000. Watter waarde word na die LED gestuur?

questions.scenario: Ayesha's LED runs from a 5 V pin. The LED drops 2 V, and the current must be 10 mA (0.01 A).
questions.scenarioAf: Ayesha se LED word deur 'n 5 V-pen aangedryf. Die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, en die stroom moet 10 mA (0,01 A) wees.

questions.q: What voltage must the resistor take?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel spanning moet oor die resistor val?

questions.q: Which resistor is needed?
questions.qAf: Watter resistor is nodig?

questions.q: The resistor goes in parallel with the LED.
questions.qAf: Die resistor gaan in parallel met die LED.
questions.explain: It goes in series.
